item.title: Jupyter Notebook on ipad and ggplot
item.description: Hey guys! I have an exam next week and of course I started preparing way too late. I'm just starting to use R on my jupyter Notebook on my Ipad Air. I'll need to use ggplot during the exam. I already downloaded the App Juno and installed ggplot on there. Sadly I have no idea how to use ggplot on my jupyter notebook. If you could give me some tips or even better a step by step guide i would really appreciate it! :)
